brief:
The European Union will continue supporting a peace plan for Gaza and work with international partners to advance a two-state solution, the bloc's foreign affairs chief said. Kaya Kallas, the EU's High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, indicated the initiative would be central to upcoming European diplomatic efforts, according to Shehab Wire.

Gaza and the West Bank are expected to feature prominently in the EU's near-term policy agenda. The statement signals the bloc's commitment to renewed engagement on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict as part of its broader strategic framework.
